deliverables.name: Explanation of team's approach
deliverables.statement: Our team conducted automated data profiling, robust regime-stratified imputation, and multi-stage anomaly detection. We separated genuine operating shifts from sensor spikes, stuck outputs, and thermal exceedances. Verified clean records trained five candidate regressors with 5-fold cross-validation. Stacking ensemble and Extra Trees achieved dominant predictive accuracy. Test predictions were generated with tree-variance uncertainty bounds and transparent multidimensional attention scoring.
